rulings.raw: 2 1/2 to 3 pounds bone-in skin-on chicken thighs (about 5 thighs)
rulings.evidence: Bone-in skin-on is its own cut and its own price - refused the bridge to Boneless Skinless Chicken Thigh (a different per-lb price and a different gram weight for the same piece) and to Rotisserie Chicken. chicken-thighs is live at 7 of 7 stores, so the id is a REUSE; only the vocabulary row is new, named with the bone/skin basis in it per the naming rulings.

rulings.raw: 5 sprigs fresh rosemary (plus additional chopped fresh rosemary for serving)
rulings.evidence: Fresh sprigs, not dried-rosemary: a sprig has no dried equivalent and the price class differs. fresh-rosemary is live at 5 of 7 stores and the DB already carries the row.
